lines.say: Sisi braided twenty seven diamond stars.

lines.text: Köchert, the Vienna court jeweler, made them for her.
lines.say: KER-khert, the Vienna court jeweler, made them for her.

lines.text: The best known stars have ten points, set with diamonds and pearls.
Reportedly, the Queen of the Night in The Magic Flute inspired them.
In 1865 she wore them at her brother's wedding in Dresden.
lines.say: In eighteen sixty five she wore them at her brother's wedding in Dresden.

lines.text: That year Winterhalter painted her in a dress covered in silver stars.
Soon stars were in fashion in hair across Europe.
Some went to her ladies in waiting and the rest to family.
Her granddaughter wore all 27 on her wedding day in 1902.
lines.say: Her granddaughter wore all twenty seven on her wedding day in nineteen oh two.

lines.text: Köchert still makes the stars from the original designs.
lines.say: KER-khert still makes the stars from the original designs.

post.caption: Empress Elisabeth of Austria, known as Sisi, owned a set of 27 diamond stars to wear in her hair. The Vienna court jeweler Koechert made them, and they are still made from the original designs. In 1865 she wore them at her brother's wedding in Dresden, and Winterhalter painted her in a dress covered with silver stars.
